How these are counted

  • A clear is one kill, not one row. The game writes a row for every character standing there when a boss dies, so a trio's kill is one clear that three people share, not three clears.
  • The Plane of Time is a run, not a boss. A clear is the whole of Phase 4 and then Quarm, timed from the first pull to the moment Quarm falls. Killing Quarm on his own is not a clear.
  • Party size is counted, never declared. Solo, duo and trio come from how many characters the game recorded on the kill.
  • The parse is a ratio to the record, inside a party size: the fastest clear is 100 and every slower one curves down from it. A ratio rather than a percentile because a percentile is a position. With two clears on the board it hands out 100 and 50 whether the runner-up was a second behind or ten minutes. A solo run is never measured against a trio.
  • Damage is the game's own figure, the total damage per second the encounter took, so it is the party's parse, not one player's.
  • A member of a duo or trio who did no damage of their own does not carry the clear's parse onto their standing. The clear still counts, at its party size, for everyone's records.
  • First clear never resets. Fastest time and top DPS change hands whenever somebody beats them.
